load_basis: LT1 allocated 5000 kg per powered truck; applied entirely as carried load for conservative side-beam screening. Not a weighed mass.
limits: Ideal simply supported beam only; ignores connection/local wall stress, torsion, braking, sidebearers, buckling, fatigue, hunting, derailment, actual axle load equalization and primary suspension. Does not release members or welds.
excluded_mass: Bearings, axleboxes, guides, springs, dampers, stops, pivot/sidebearers, motors, reductions, shafts, brakes, hoses, guards, weld metal and fasteners.

LT1_clearance_conflict.resolution: Locomotive frame arrangement must be revised/coordinated. Do not drill/weld to LT1 frame. No agreed final mainframe underside elevation or truck pivot exists. Rotated envelope and sidebearer motion require further work.
